question: Why does FreeLoader reset on the Acer and the ThinkPad when the same boot CD reaches the kernel in QEMU?
allowedInputs: Reported: both laptops reset in FreeLoader and QEMU still boots
Reported: an Acer Linux 5.15 dump with an e820 reserved hole, an Insyde WDAT table, and NM10 LPC 8086:27bc. The dump was not given a path.
https://uefi.org/specs/UEFI/2.10/07_Services_Boot_Services.html ExitBootServices returns EFI_INVALID_PARAMETER when MapKey is stale, and GetMemoryMap must be called again

harness.guest: QEMU SeaBIOS, amd64 boot CD, TCG
harness.name: local qemu
harness.traceOrReplayId: source/output/freeldr-tco-smoke2.log reached the kernel on the watchdog-halt image. The final notice change was not booted.

cursor.prompt: Implement the Acer watchdog and reserved-hole changes so the boot CD can be tested, then halt the watchdog before the last BIOS call. Commit and push the laptop handoff once QEMU still boots.

measuredEffect.note: The user reported that QEMU still boots and that the Acer still resets after the debugger notice. No committed harness score.
